standard.summary: 注入层 可选值（含换档影响）。
standard.effect: 枚举切换会改变算法或资源行为。
standard.avoidWhen: 未理解影响前不要叠多个激进档。

optionDescriptions.self_attn_q: 只打 self-attn 的 Q，控制弱一点。
optionDescriptions.self_attn_qkv_cross_q: self QKV 再加 cross 的 Q。
optionDescriptions.self_attn_q_pre,mlp_fc1_pre: Q 前和 MLP 前两个点都打，覆盖面大。

standard_en.summary: Injection layers -- the options below, including what changing level does.
standard_en.effect: Switching the value changes algorithm or resource behaviour.
standard_en.whenToUse: Prefer the default, then change after a short test.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not stack several aggressive levels before you understand their effect.

optionDescriptions.self_attn_q: Only the self-attention Q, so control is on the weaker side.
optionDescriptions.self_attn_qkv: All of Q, K and V, so control is strong.
optionDescriptions.self_attn_qkv_cross_q: Self-attention QKV plus the cross-attention Q.
optionDescriptions.self_attn_q_pre,mlp_fc1_pre: Both the pre-Q and pre-MLP points, so the coverage is wide.
